Jordan (Product): Quick: we need a concise playbook for the console observability work so PMs can scope customer asks. Focus: per-route cost, lightweight trace hooks, and actionable error analytics. Can we draft minimal launch gates + rollback criteria?

Priya (Eng-runtime): I'll sketch a delivery plan. Key constraints: tracing must be async, nonblocking. Cost attribution depends on token accounting being reliable.

Dan (Eng-SRE): Ops guardrails: default sampling 0.5% (configurable), burst capture mode for incidents, and a daily cap per-org. Also retention tiers: 7/30/365 days.

Lina (Design): For console, propose three panels: Cost Overview (route/model), Traces (sampled list + link to flamegraph), Errors (grouped, sample input toggle). I'll mock compact layouts for both small account pages and large org pages.

Mateo (Data): Metric schema draft: metric_name: "inference.request" tags: [org_id, route, model, variant, user_tier], fields: tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms, success_bool. Cost calc = tokens_in * model.unit_cost + tokens_out * model.unit_cost + infra_overhead.

Jordan (Product): Launch gates proposal: 1) Cost numbers within 7% of billing for beta orgs, 2) Trace capture adds <10% tail latency, 3) Error groups show top-5 and include sample input for at least 80% of distinct errors.

Priya (Eng-runtime): Implementation notes: we'll add a nonblocking plugin hook before/after model run that emits a span envelope to the trace service. Sampling config example: ```yaml
default_rate: 0.005
overrides:
  - when: route == \"embed\"
    rate: 0.01
  - when: latency_ms > 1000
    rate: 1.0
burst_capacity: 2000 # spans per minute
quota_per_org_per_day: 100000
```

Dan (Eng-SRE): Ops checks before beta: load test with synthetic spans at 10x expected, validate autoscale for trace consumers, ensure alerts on >2x expected error rate.

Lina (Design): UX acceptance: drilldown from cost row -> sample traces/errors; trace link should open in existing trace viewer; error sample should be redacted by default with "show sample" control.

Mateo (Data): Backfill plan: if org opts in, recompute last 30 days using batch job; estimated job cost: ~4 GPU-hours per 100M requests. Will need a flag to prevent accidental wide backfills.

Jordan (Product): Rollout strategy: feature-flagged beta to 3 customers + internal teams for 4 weeks. Metrics to watch: trace volume, token accounting variance, error group coverage. Rollback criteria: >10% billing variance or sustained p99 latency regression >15% after rollout.

Priya (Eng-runtime): Dev checklist: SDK hooks for manual trace trigger, server-side sampling config, async ingestion client, perf regression tests.

Dan (Eng-SRE): I'll add infra tickets and sizing doc. Need estimate of spans/day from PMs for the three beta customers.

release-bot: Created ticket OBS-2024: "Console observability playbook + MVP" -> https://redwood.example/OBS-2024

Jordan (Product): Thanks — I'll draft the playbook doc and share a short checklist for PMs to use when they surface customer asks. Anyone object to the gates above?

Priya (Eng-runtime): No objections.

Lina (Design): SGTM.

Mateo (Data): SGTM.

Dan (Eng-SRE): SGTM.

Jordan (Product): Great. Closing thread — will send doc link when ready. :rocket:
